description: This PHP source file defines the EcrClient class, which interacts with the Amazon EC2 Container Registry (ECR) service. It includes method annotations indicating various operations such as creating repositories, deleting images, describing registries, and more, primarily for interfacing with AWS ECR.

classes.name: EcrClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS ECR, extending the general AwsClient class, providing specific methods to interact with the EC2 Container Registry service.

methods.name: batchCheckLayerAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability of image layers in bulk.

methods.name: batchDeleteImage
methods.description: Deletes multiple images from a repository.

methods.name: createRepository
methods.description: Creates a new container image repository.

methods.name: getAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization token for Docker client authentication.

methods.name: putImage
methods.description: Stores an image in a repository.
